_comment: Cowork runs hooks only in Cowork, not in chat (grayed out there). Codex reads this file when bundled into a plugin, via its own hooks/hooks.json convention, but installing the plugin does not auto-trust the hooks; a human has to review and trust them separately. Cursor does not read this file at all; it uses its own hooks/hooks.json event names (afterFileEdit, beforeShellExecution, sessionEnd, and so on), see the Cursor section of harness-specific-reference.md.
